ignore.reason: False positive: the word 'right-click' in English UI prose (mouse button), not a CSS class. Scoped to i18n-renderer.js lines with that prose (the detector truncates the tray.hideHint line before 'right-click').
Desktop Windows app: Segoe UI is the native Windows UI font with full Hebrew coverage; BRAND.md specifies 'system-ui / Segoe UI (Windows native)'.

Handled in CSS instead of dir=auto: these fields use unicode-bidi: plaintext (settings.css / popup.css / clipboard-history.css 'Bidi' blocks), which is per-line and keeps the RTL caret/placeholder when empty (dir=auto turns an empty field LTR in Chromium). Verified live in browser-after.json fields.
Machine formats, not display: Google Calendar URL dates (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS) in detectors/datetime.js and the ZIP DOS date field in zip-writer.js.
Keyboard handling that is already direction-aware (Left = next in RTL), not an icon.
